subject.title: [Feature]: Add JSON-RPC bindings for language-agnostic plugins

question: Should OpenClaw accept a public language-neutral JSON-RPC plugin ABI now, and should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98005 be the protocol-v1 implementation path?
rationale: This is a new public plugin SDK/manifest execution boundary, not a broken existing behavior, and the repository policy treats plugin API, compatibility, availability, and security-boundary choices as maintainer-owned decisions.

options.title: Review the linked PR as protocol v1
options.body: Use the linked PR as the canonical implementation review and explicitly accept, narrow, or request changes to the ABI before merge.

options.title: Keep design open and pause implementation
options.body: Leave this issue open as a design record if the child-process lifecycle or support contract is not ready to freeze.

options.title: Decline a core ABI for now
options.body: Close or retarget the work if maintainers decide non-TypeScript plugin bridges should remain external or one-off until stronger demand appears.

recommendation.title: Review the linked PR as protocol v1
recommendation.body: Use the linked PR as the canonical implementation review and explicitly accept, narrow, or request changes to the ABI before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter's history covers the original plugin architecture, plugin-managed hooks, and public SDK entrypoint documentation, making him the strongest routing candidate for the SDK/API direction decision.
